categoryWiseBreakdown.post: विशेष चयन: सहायक समीक्षा अधिकारी लेखा

keyDates.otrCutoff: Must obtain OTR number at least 72 hours before online application

eligibilitySummary.ro: Bachelor's Degree from a University established by law in India or recognized equivalent. For Account post: Bachelor's degree in commerce with Accountancy.
eligibilitySummary.aro: Bachelor's Degree + DOEACC / NIELIT 'O' Level (or recognized equivalent diploma as per UP GO dated 05/05/2022) + Minimum 25 words per minute in Hindi typing on Computer (Kruti Dev 010 / Mangal). English typing is preferential.
eligibilitySummary.ageLimit: 21 to 40 years as on July 01, 2026 (Candidates must not have been born earlier than 2nd July 1986 and not later than 1st July 2005). Relaxations: SC/ST/OBC/State Govt Employees/Skilled Players: +5 years (up to 45 yrs); PwD: +15 years (up to 55 yrs); CM Fellowship Scholars: up to +3 years.

selectionProcess: Stage 1: Preliminary Exam (Objective - 200 Questions / 200 Marks / 3 Hours: 140 GS + 60 General Hindi) with 0.33 negative marking
Stage 2: Main Examination (800 Marks Conventional: Paper 1 GS-I 200M + Paper 2 GS-II 200M + Paper 3 Hindi & Drafting 200M + Paper 4 Essay 200M)
Stage 3: Hindi Typing Qualification Test (Compulsory for ARO posts on Computer at 25 wpm)
Selection purely based on Main Examination (800 Marks) + CM Fellowship Weightage where applicable. No Interview.
specialProvisions2026: 15 times candidates of total vacancies (15 x 501 = 7,515 candidates) shall qualify Prelims for Main Examination.
Minimum efficiency standard: 35% for SC/ST and 40% for General, EWS and OBC categories in Prelims and Mains.
Three-copy OMR sheet: Pink (Original to UPPSC), Green (Preserved), Blue (Candidate Copy).
Strict penal action under Uttar Pradesh Examination (Prevention of Unfair Means) Act, 2024 dated August 6, 2024 and Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) for malpractice/forgery.
